partners.title: Plant a native tree
partners.desc: One native whip, planted this season. Oak, birch, rowan or hazel, depending on the site. Envie will show you the spot.

partners.title: Pollinator meadow
partners.desc: Ten square metres of native wildflower verge, sown and left uncut through the summer for bees and hoverflies.

partners.title: Seagrass restoration
partners.desc: A square metre of seagrass meadow replanted at a pilot site. Seagrass stores carbon and shelters young fish.
